title: add-semantic-cohort-anchor-and-confidence-calibration-gate
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a semantic cohort anchor used by CI to detect prompt-set regressions with calibrated confidence thresholds; installs a gated rollback hook to automatically open a remediation patch when a sustained regression is detected.
description: Motivation: Our existing cohort stability checks operate primarily on token-level or surface metrics and can miss subtle semantic regressions (e.g., consistent shift in meaning or intent matching). This PR introduces a semantic-cohort anchor and a confidence-calibrated gate that complements existing numeric guards by measuring changes in semantic intent score distributions over time. The gate is designed to be conservative (low false positives) and actionable: when triggered it creates a regression alert in Linear and opens an automatic rollback branch for the last model rollout. Key features: - semantic_cohort_anchor: a small, curated cohort of prompts with labeled intents and multiple reference responses; embeddings-based similarity scoring with temperature-aware aggregation. - confidence_calibration: per-cohort calibration layer that converts raw similarity deltas into a normalized confidence score, factoring historical variance and sample size. - gated_rollback_hook: CI hook that triggers when the calibrated confidence score crosses the configured threshold for N consecutive runs; creates a remediation Linear ticket and a rollback patch branch. - smoke/e2e integrations: a lightweight smoke test that runs on PRs touching prompt sets or scoring code and returns a warning-level result when the confidence delta is borderline. Implementation notes: - New module eval_harness/semantics/anchor.py implements anchor ingestion, indexed embeddings, and fast pairwise comparisons; accepts both model-generated and human reference embeddings. - Calibration code is in eval_harness/semantics/calibrator.py and stores per-cohort statistics in an append-only JSON snapshot under eval_harness/semantics/snapshots/. Snapshots are intentionally compact to avoid CI storage bloat. - CI integration: eval-harness/.github/workflows/semantic-anchor-ci.yml wires the histogram-based gate into the existing eval CI pipeline; when the gate fails it creates a Regression task via the existing automation and includes a small artifact (top-N prompt diffs). - Backwards compatibility: the gate is opt-in via eval config (eval_config.yaml) and defaults to disabled for older cohorts. Migration: added a small script tools/semantics/generate-anchor-seed.py to create initial cohort files from an export of our manual prompt review sheet. Testing: unit tests + integration smoke in eval_harness/tests/semantics_test.py. See linked Linear items for evaluation criteria and rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] Core scoring and calibration implementation - [x] CI hook + workflow - [x] Unit tests and e2e smoke - [x] Linear integration for automatic task creation - [x] Documentation stub in docs/semantics.md Follow-ups tracked in ENG-2213 for expanding cohort coverage and ENG-2261 for adding per-team thresholds.
